observation.visible_scene: A tall, clear plastic beverage dispenser with a dark maroon lid sits on a table, filled with a clear liquid. A small raised spout on the left side of the lid continuously emits a white vapor that rises and drifts upward. Two empty clear glass pitchers sit in the foreground left and right, and a lit red candle with greenery is visible in the blurred background left. A person in a dark blue long-sleeved top stands behind the dispenser; a ring is visible on one hand.
visible_changes: The camera gradually pushes in / zooms: the dispenser grows larger in frame while the foreground glass pitchers and most of the candle drift out of view toward the edges and bottom.
The person's hands start clasped together at the upper right, then separate and move leftward and downward to hover, palms-down and fingers spread, over the top of the lid.
The left hand's fingers come to rest very near the vapor-emitting spout, hovering just above it without any clearly visible contact.
The white vapor keeps rising steadily from the spout throughout the clip, expanding and diffusing as it ascends; its source and rate appear unchanged.
The candle flame flickers slightly in shape and brightness; the hinged flap on the right of the lid stays closed; the liquid level in the dispenser remains constant.
outside_clip_unknowns: What is inside the dispenser producing the vapor (e.g., dry ice) and how it was placed there is not shown.
Whether the hovering hand ultimately touches the spout, lifts the lid, or moves away is not shown.
The person's purpose or speech and the full body are not visible.
uncertain_details: The enlargement of the dispenser is camera motion (zoom/dolly-in), not the dispenser moving; the slight vertical reframe makes exact camera path uncertain.
It is unclear whether the hand merely hovers near the spout or makes light contact, since the vapor partially obscures the gap.
The vapor's apparent redirection near the hand could be airflow from the hand or just diffusion; not determinable from these frames.
